name: UFC | svc.sync_bout_ids
description: Gives every fight a stable bout_id: writes Fight Card column I and re-keys Picks, Props and Fight Analysis rows from fight_order to bout IDs. Writes only those columns, verifies by read-back, and is a no-op when already in sync.

nodeGroups.name: Read card and pick tabs
nodeGroups.description: Load the saved card state, Fight Card and the Picks, Props and Fight Analysis tabs, then plan the bout_id column writes.

nodeGroups.name: Verify written columns
nodeGroups.description: Read every tab back and confirm each written column holds exactly the planned values.
